firstAccount.title: No account yet?
firstAccount.body: This skeleton folds registration into the sign-in flow and ships neither SMS nor social sign-in, so a fresh deployment has no account to sign in with. Write the first one with the server's seed command, then sign in here (see starters/demo/AGENTS.md).
